# agent-sprite-forge

The pixel-art versions of the ghost-side sprites in `art/px/` were made with the pixel finish of
agent-sprite-forge (`skills/video2dsprite/scripts/finish_frames.py pixel`), run on this game's own
HD frames. The tool itself is not shipped with the game.

agent-sprite-forge: https://github.com/0x0funky/agent-sprite-forge
